note: Generated by design/tools/boss_longwave.py. World units. Shapes are local to their part, x forward along the body, as [x0,y0,x1,y1,layer] (0 hull, 1 inner mark, 2 core line). The body's colour runs along it: enemy hue 1 at the head, hue 2 in the middle, hue 3 at the tail, each toward its partner at the flanks; segments are drawn as elites. The crest segment is drawn white-hot.

fin.note: two blades, one per flank: [(-4, 21), (-30, 21 + reach), (12, 21)] and its mirror; reach follows the wave: crestReach on the flank the segment is swinging toward at its crest, closedReach otherwise

seed.note: the light inside the jaw: the head's weak point

spine.note: one line through every live segment, head to tail

wave.rule: sideways offset of live segment k = amplitude x min(1, k / taperSegments) x sin(2 pi (k / wavelength - steps / wavelength)), steps = grid steps since the fight began. The segment where the sine is +1 is the crest; where it is -1, the trough. The crest moves one segment toward the tail on every step.
wave.crestWindow: a segment is the crest for the whole step in which the sine peaks on it

path.shape: figure of eight: x = halfWidth x cos(p), y = halfHeight x sin(2p) around the anchor
path.anchor: the centre of the players when it arrives, kept at least 1100 wu from every wall
path.segments: segment k sits on the same path, k x spacing behind the head along it, then swings sideways with the wave
path.continuity: p advances at the phase's rate; a phase change alters the rate, never p, so the body never jumps

camera.note: eased over the entrance bar; back to 1 over a bar when it dies

phases.name: Swell
phases.note: slower than the ship: fly along with a crest

fire.pattern: one to each side, square to the body

phases.name: Chop
phases.note: just faster than the ship: each crest overtakes you slowly

fire.pattern: a fan of three to each side, 16 degrees apart

phases.name: Whitecap
phases.note: crests whip past; the body is short, so stay beside it

lunge.note: a dashed line from the head through where the nearest player stood at the start of the telegraph bar; on the next downbeat the head dashes along it and its jaw stays open for two beats

headBurst.note: alternate rings turned half a step

whip.when: the downbeat after each phase change
whip.note: a ring from the tail tip; the tail cracks like a whip

jaw.open: the whole of beat 1 of every bar
jaw.note: the head takes full damage through the open jaw and a quarter on the closed one; a horn marks the opening

music.layer: a rubber-string run: the bass patch one octave up with decay x 2, one note on every crest step
music.rule: the note is the crest's place in its wave (0-7) as a degree of the Track's scale above the chord root: 0 2 3 5 7 8 10 12. The crest running down the body is heard as a scale running up; when the wave speeds up, so does the run
music.trough: the telegraph tick on every step a trough fires
music.jaw: the elite-arrives patch (a low fifth) on beat 1 while the jaw is open
music.whip: the impact sample, pitched up a fifth, on the whip's downbeat

accent.use: fins, crown, eyes and the spine's core line: a boss is the one enemy with a second colour family, the complement of its Track's palette

echoes.note: the spine line only, drawn where the body was that fraction of a wave ago
the spine line only, drawn where the body was that fraction of a wave ago

numbers.entrance: on the Drop's downbeat the head breaks in from the nearest wall and the body follows it onto the figure of eight over two bars, already waving; the name card LONGWAVE holds for two bars
numbers.segmentDeath: the segment shatters along the wave's direction, its neighbours snap together with a white flash at the join, and the crest skips on without missing a step
numbers.death: the jaw locks open, the clamped white flash, what is left of the body unravels tail-first one segment per sixteenth, each a medium kill, then the head as a boss break: three rings, 300+ sparks, 30 px distortion ring, 50 ms hit-stop, then 200 Shards
